British Values
As an important part of our integrated approach to Spiritual, Moral, Social & Cultural education at Beddington Park Academy, we promote children’s understanding of British values by embedding them across the school curriculum so that they permeate children’s learning as well as influence the values and ethos of the school.
It is our aim to ensure that children at Beddington Park Academy understand and actively participate in democracy, understand the difference between right and wrong, understand the rule of law, know their own personal rights and responsibilities and are mutually respectful and tolerant to those with different faiths and beliefs. pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Regional Director - Beddington Park Academy
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Regional Director
I am honoured to welcome you to Beddington Park Academy. This website has been constructed to give you a flavour of what our school has to offer your child.
Beddington Park Academy is a two form entry school with a nursery building set in grounds on the edge of Beddington Park. Choosing the right school for your child’s education is an important decision. At Beddington, we pride ourselves on the relationships we have with our children and families, ensuring that all children are known, valued and their individual needs recognised and met. As part of STEP Academy Trust, we promote five key values throughout all our learning and everything we do: Passion, Urgency, Positivity, Aspiration and Commitment.
We carefully consider what knowledge and skills children will need to have in order to be successful in an ever-changing future. We have high academic aspirations for all our children and as a result standards are high. However, it is equally important that they develop and grow into well-rounded individuals, with an intellectual curiosity to become good learners.
We aim for our children to strive for success and persevere when they are challenged but equally to know how to win with dignity and lose with grace. Through innovative teaching and a broad, balanced and creative curriculum, our children receive memorable experiences both in and out of the classroom.
At Beddington Park, we have specialist teachers for sport and music (including piano, drumming and singing teaching).
We also work towards an end of year achievement awards, which promotes the arts and all pupils achievements. We continue to further develop our facilities inside and outside of the academy and our latest investment has been in the re-development of our EYFS outdoor area.

As a school, we are committed to providing the highest standards of education and are excited about the opportunities and achievements that lie ahead. We warmly welcome visitors and invite you to contact the school office to arrange a tour. We would be delighted to share with you all that makes our school such a positive and inspiring place to learn and grow.

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Head Teacher - Beddington Park Academy
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Head Teacher
Welcome to Beddington Park Academy. Our school provides a safe, exciting and challenging learning environment where every child is encouraged to be the best that they can be.
Our school has a strong tradition of celebrating achievement and encouraging the children to be aspirational. Our weekly Celebration Assemblies are used to formally celebrate and reward children’s achievements in class and outside of school.
We also have our PUPAC reward system in school which promotes positive behaviour. At the end of the school year we have a range of cups and trophies which are presented in our Prize Giving Ceremony for academic achievement and citizenship.
Citizenship is a very important aspect of our school life. The Pupil Parliament represents pupil views and meets with the Headteacher, a Senior Teacher and a Governors regularly. Pupil voice is an important part of school life from EYFS to Y6. Children’s ideas for improving our school are discussed and acted upon.
We hope that the information and content on this site will give you an overview into the life and work of our school. If you require any further details please ring the school and we will be happy to help.

pageCache.pageTitle: Art & DT - Subjects - Beddington Park Academy
pageCache.text:
Art & DT
At Beddington Park Academy, we are dedicated to nurturing the artistic talents and creative spirits of young learners.
Art is more than just colours on a canvas or shapes on paper; it's a powerful means of self-expression and communication. Our art curriculum is designed to introduce students to a wide variety of artistic mediums and techniques. From painting and drawing to sculpture and digital art, we encourage students to explore their unique artistic interests and develop their skills. At Beddington Park Academy, there is no limit to what students can create.
We also believe that design and technology is the cornerstone of innovation and creativity. Our primary school is committed to providing an exciting and hands-on learning experience that empowers young minds to become the designers, engineers, and problem solvers of the future.
Design and technology education is essential because it equips students with the skills and knowledge needed to navigate a rapidly changing world. It fosters critical thinking, creativity, and practical problem-solving abilities. At Beddington Park Academy, we understand that design and technology is not just a subject; it helps in shaping a better future.
Our curriculum encourages students to explore a wide range of design and technology concepts and projects. From crafting intricate models to designing sustainable solutions. We empower students to think creatively and make a real impact on the world around them.

pageCache.pageTitle: RE / RSE / PSHCE - Subjects - Beddington Park Academy
pageCache.text:
RE / RSE / PSHCE
At Beddington Park Academy, we believe Religious Education is a vital part of fostering respect and a deeper understanding of diverse cultures and faiths.
Our primary school provides a Religious Education curriculum that encourages students to explore beliefs, learn about different world religions and promote values that create respectful members of society. Religious Education is not just about imparting knowledge of different faiths; it is about teaching tolerance and respect for diverse cultures and beliefs. It promotes critical thinking, ethical reasoning, and a sense of responsibility towards the world.
Our Religious Education curriculum takes students on a journey to explore the rich tapestry of world religions. They learn about the beliefs, practices, and traditions of different faiths. Through this exploration, students gain a deeper appreciation for the diversity of human beliefs and experiences.
At Beddington Park Academy, we guide our learners to becoming well-rounded, emotionally intelligent and responsible young individuals.
RSE and PSHCE are integral parts of our curriculum, designed to equip primary school children with the knowledge, skills, and values they need to thrive in an ever-changing world. The curriculum focuses on the development of essential life skills, empathy, resilience, and self-awareness.
Healthy Relationships: We teach the children the foundations of healthy relationships, emphasising respect, consent, communication, and empathy. Children learn how to form positive connections with their peers, families, and communities.
Emotional Intelligence: Our curriculum helps children understand and manage their emotions. They learn to recognise and express feelings constructively, fostering self-awareness and empathy for others.
Physical and Mental Health: We educate our children about the importance of maintaining physical and mental well-being. Topics include nutrition, exercise, and strategies for managing stress and emotions.
Citizenship and Social Responsibility: We promote a sense of social responsibility and global citizenship, encouraging children to make informed choices and contribute positively to their communities and the world.
Online Safety: In today's digital age, we teach students how to navigate the online world safely and responsibly, addressing cyberbullying and privacy.
Diversity and Inclusion: Our curriculum celebrates diversity and teaches children to respect and embrace differences. We promote an inclusive and tolerant school community.
Values and Ethics: We explore ethical dilemmas and our in discussions about moral values, enabling them to make thoughtful decisions aligned with their principles.
Parental Involvement: We believe in the importance of collaboration between school and parents. We keep parents informed and involved in their child's education, offering guidance on how to continue these essential conversations at home

pageCache.pageTitle: History & Geography - Subjects - Beddington Park Academy
pageCache.text:
History & Geography
At Beddington Park Academy, we embark on an exciting journey through the realms of history and geography.
Our primary school is dedicated to providing an engaging history and geography curriculum that not only educates but also inspires young minds to explore the past and understand the world around them.
History and Geography are more than just subjects; they are windows into the past and present, helping students make sense of the world and their place in it. History teaches critical thinking, empathy, and an appreciation for diverse cultures and perspectives. Geography enhances spatial awareness and promotes environmental responsibility. We understand that these subjects are key to becoming informed and responsible citizens of the world.
In our history program, students travel back in time to explore the fascinating stories of civilisations, leaders, and everyday people who have shaped our world. They uncover the mysteries of ancient Egypt, experience the excitement of the Ancient Romans, and learn about pivotal moments in history like the World War Two. Our students develop a deeper understanding of the past and the lessons it offers for the future.
In our Geography curriculum, students embark on a global adventure to discover the diverse landscapes, cultures, and ecosystems of our planet. They explore the wonders of the Amazon Rainforest, unravel the mysteries of the world, and study the cultures of countries near and far. Our students gain a profound appreciation for the beauty and complexity of the world they inhabit.

Music
At Beddington Park Academy, we believe that music is a universal language that brings joy, creativity, and a sense of community to our primary school experience.
Our vibrant music curriculum is designed to ignite the passion for music in our young learners, fostering their musical talents and nurturing their appreciation for the art.
Music is an integral part of our curriculum because it enriches children's lives in numerous ways. It enhances cognitive development, boosts self-esteem, and teaches discipline and teamwork. Through music, children learn to express themselves, think critically, and connect with others on a profound level. It more than just notes and melodies; it's a journey of self-discovery.
Music comes alive when shared with an audience, and our school takes great pride in hosting our annual concert at Farfield Halls. This event gives our children the chance to showcase their talents, build confidence, and connect with the school community.
At Beddington Park Academy, we believe that every child has a unique melody waiting to be heard, and we are here to help them find their voice in the world of music.

pageCache.pageTitle: Physical Education - Subjects - Beddington Park Academy
pageCache.text:
Physical Education
At Beddington Park Academy, we believe that physical education is not just about fitness; it's a holistic approach to nurturing healthy bodies, active minds, and lifelong well-being.
Our primary school is dedicated to providing a dynamic and comprehensive physical education curriculum that inspires students to embrace a healthy and active lifestyle.Physical education plays a vital role in a child's development. It promotes physical fitness, builds motor skills, and enhances coordination. Beyond the physical benefits, it fosters teamwork, sportsmanship, and self-confidence.
Our curriculum offers a wide range of sports and activities for students to explore. From traditional team sports like netball and cricket to individual activities like gymnastics and dance, we encourage students to discover their physical interests and develop their skills.
We believe in the powerful connection between physical and mental health. Our curriculum emphasises the importance of regular exercise in reducing stress, improving focus, and enhancing overall well-being. Students learn that staying active is not just good for their bodies but also for their minds. We aim to instil lifelong healthy habits in our students. They learn about the importance of regular exercise, balanced nutrition, and staying active throughout their lives. These lessons are the foundation of a lifetime of well-being.

pageCache.pageTitle: Early Years - Subjects - Beddington Park Academy
pageCache.text:
Early Years
Our vision begins in Early Years where we develop the foundations for learning. We aim to provide children with the most positive start to their educational life, enabling all children to enjoy learning.
We endeavour to support children so that they become confident, independent and balanced individuals who are able to reach their full potential in all areas of their development. In order to do this, we work hard to provide high quality provision both indoors and outdoors in order to develop a love of learning. This provision is set within a safe and stimulating environment where diversity is celebrated and achievements are recognised.
The Early Years Foundation Stage Curriculum
At Beddington Park Academy, we use the Early Years Foundation Stage Statutory Framework to inform and support our planning and to enhance our assessment procedures. This guidance sets out the Early Learning Goals which children are expected to achieve by the end of reception. There are three prime areas and four specific areas included within the Early Learning Goals.
Communication and Language underpins all learning. We understand the importance of supporting and facilitating back-and-forth interactions from an early age. At Beddington Park Academy, children are supported by their peers and adults throughout the day in a language-rich environment. Practitioners will regularly comment on what children are doing, incorporate new vocabulary into conversations and echo back what children say, adding additional vocabulary as they do so. In both nursery and reception, children in engage in both rhyme time and story time each day, allowing them to become immersed in language. Children enjoy actively participating in these sessions whether through actions, discussions or song. Within our provision, we also ensure that children have a variety of opportunity to engage in role play alongside their peers, developing their own story telling and use of communication. We endeavour to make our role plays areas exciting and stimulating for the children, but role-play can happen anywhere. Practitioners enjoying engaging with children during role play or small world play through modelling or questioning, which allows children to elaborate on their story-telling and become more confident within the language structures that they use.
PSED (personal, social emotional development) is critical for very young children in all aspects of their lives and gives them the best opportunity for successes in all areas of learning. At Beddington Park Academy, we strive to ensure that all children learn the skills necessary in order to work, play and co-operate with others. Children should feel safe, secure and respect themselves and others in order to develop a positive self-image. In Early Years, children learn how to build relationships with peers and adults and begin to understand how to express and regulate their emotions. As practitioners, our aim is to support and develop this through the delivery of safe and stimulating curriculum. Children will also learn how to look after their bodies, including how to eat healthily and how to manage their personal needs independently.
Physical Development is vital in a child’s all-round development. At Beddington Park Academy, we understand that through developing a child’s physical skills, they will be able to pursue happy, healthy and active lives. Our curriculum strives to develop both the fine and gross motor skills of a child. Fine motor skills are the ability to make movements using the small muscles in our hands and wrists. Throughout their time at Beddington Park Academy, children will engage with numerous activities that facilitate this including using playdoh, peg boards, tweezers, fishing rods, threading, cutting etc. Fine motor control and precision helps with hand-eye co-ordination, which is later linked to early literacy.
Gross motor skills involve using large muscles in our torso, legs and arms in a coordinated way. Within our setting, children are encouraged to practise their climbing and balance skills using our outdoor apparatus and are given time to explore, experiment and refine movements within a safe, planned and well-resourced learning environment. Our practitioners create games and provide opportunities for play both indoors and outdoors, to support children to develop their core strength, stability, balance, spatial awareness, co-ordination and agility.
In Early Years, we form the stepping stones for all children to learn the foundations of literacy. We teach the children the skills they need to build and develop their phonological awareness. At Beddington Park Academy, we provide children with lots of opportunities around their environment to mark make, write and read. It is crucial for children to develop a life-long love of reading and we embed this through teaching children songs, poems and rhymes. During these sessions, we teach essential comprehension skills to enhance inference and speech development. Children will learn how to read individual sounds, diagraphs, trigraphs and sight words. We understand the relationship between physical development and writing and so we offer a wide range of activities for children to strengthen their pencil grip in order to become fluent writers.
Mathematics teaches essential life-long skills for all children to develop and excel in. We provide children with high quality provision that is both resourceful and accessible. Children are taught how to count confidently, develop a deep understanding of the numbers to 10 and the relationships between them, including the patterns within those numbers. By providing frequent and varied opportunities to build and apply this understanding, children will develop a secure base of knowledge and vocabulary from which mathematics is built. At Beddington Park Academy, we aim to provide rich opportunities where children learn across all areas of mathematics. It is vital that children develop positive attitudes and interests in mathematics, observing patterns, relationships and spotting connections.
Understanding the World focuses on guiding children to make sense of their physical world and their community. At Beddington Park Academy, we encourage the children to share their experiences from home, to help broaden everyone’s knowledge and understanding of different cultures and heritages. We learn about different celebrations throughout the year and encourage the children to try foods from around the world. We endeavor to ensure that our resources reflect our diverse community, allowing every child to see themselves. We spend time looking at different people in our community and use our role-play areas to provide hands-on experiences. Our children can be anything from firefighters to postal workers, police officers to bus drivers or even doctors and vets. This helps to build their knowledge and develop their vocabulary, which will later support their reading comprehension. Practitioners facilitate children’s natural curiosity through providing opportunities for children to explore the world around them, including the effect of different seasons and changes in states of matter.
Expressive Arts and Design encompasses all things creative and imaginative. At Beddington Park Academy, we provide a rich creative environment to ensure the children have the opportunity to explore and develop their creative side. The children will have opportunities to create music, dance, sing and perform on our wonderful outside stage. They have access to a wide variety of art materials to allow them to plan and design an original piece of artwork or sculpture. We change our role-plays frequently to provide our children with broad experiences linked to our themes. The children also have opportunities to perform for their parents throughout the year.

Computing
At Beddington Park Academy, we empower young minds with the knowledge and skills to navigate the digital age confidently. In today's world, computing is not just a subject; it is a fundamental skill that opens doors to endless possibilities.
Computing education is essential because it equips students with critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and digital literacy. It is not just about using computers; it is about understanding how they work, coding, and harnessing technology to create, innovate, and communicate. These skills are not only valuable for future careers but also for everyday life.
Coding is the language of the future, and we believe in introducing students to it from an early age. Our curriculum includes age-appropriate coding activities and projects that teach students the fundamentals of programming. They will learn to create games, animations, and websites while developing logical thinking and problem-solving skills. Our students are encouraged to think outside the box, experiment, and solve real-world problems using technology.
In addition to technical skills, we emphasise the importance of digital citizenship and online safety. Our students learn how to use technology responsibly and ethically. They understand the risks of the digital world and how to protect themselves and others online, ensuring a safe and positive digital experience.

English
At Beddington Park Academy, we believe English lessons are a gateway to knowledge, creativity, and effective communication.
We understand that the journey to English excellence begins with a love for reading. Our curriculum cultivates this love by exposing students to a rich tapestry of literature and engaging them in captivating stories.
We prioritise building a solid foundation in English language skills, including reading comprehension, grammar, spelling, writing and vocabulary. These skills are fundamental to success across all subjects.
We introduce students to classic and contemporary literature, sparking their imaginations and broadening their horizons. We challenge students to explore texts, dissect themes and express their thoughts effectively. This equips students with the ability to communicate clearly, both in writing and speaking. Effective communication is a life skill that opens doors in the classroom and beyond.
We encourage parents to actively engage in their child's English education. We provide resources and support to continue learning at home.

At Beddington Park Academy, we want our children to be resilient mathematicians who enjoy the sense of curiosity and discovery that Mathematics brings.
Mathematics teaches us how to make sense of the world, and we aim for all children to leave school with the foundation for understanding the world. Our children are given opportunities to regularly connect to other subjects and everyday life to support this understanding. Our Mathematics Mastery curriculum has been developed to ensure every child can achieve in Mathematics through practical, real-life, relevant experiences.

P4C
At Beddington Park Academy, we believe that nurturing young thinkers is not just about teaching facts; it is about empowering them with the tools to explore life's profound questions.
Philosophy for Children, or P4C, is an innovative educational approach designed to do just that. In each session, the children are shown a stimulus and through careful facilitation, the children share their ideas and develop their skills to ask open-ended questions and build on each other’s points of view
We encourage students to think deeply, ask meaningful questions, and engage in thoughtful discussions. P4C helps them develop the ability to be caring, critical, collaborative and creative thinkers. Through dialogue and debate, children learn to articulate their thoughts and opinions confidently. This skill extends beyond the classroom, empowering them in everyday life.
P4C provides a safe space for children to explore big philosophical questions like "What is fairness?" or "What makes a good friend?" These discussions are both enriching and enjoyable. Our P4C lessons promote respect for diverse viewpoints and teaches children how to listen actively and empathise with others.
